newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian coconut oil softens, copra up.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian coconut oil softens, copra up.

text.p: Indonesian coconut oil prices suffered extended losses amid poor market sentiment on Thursday, but copra was higher on rising demand, traders said.

"Coconut oil prices continue to fall because oil is abundant in the market. On the other hand, copra prices are up because industrial demand such as from cookie factories is quite high," said one trader in Jakarta.
Traders said consumer demand for copra was also high from buyers who would later sell it in local markets. Coconut oil was quoted at 1,790 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, down from 1,810-20 a week ago.
